$description: Figma-only Tooltip component tokens. Every value aliases a semantic token; code consumes the semantic tokens directly.

$descriptions.container: Tooltip fill. Bind to: tooltip frame fill.
$descriptions.label: Tooltip text colour. Bind to: tooltip text fill.
$descriptions.radius: Corner radius. Bind to: frame corner radius.
$descriptions.padding-block: Top and bottom padding. Bind to: top and bottom padding.
$descriptions.padding-inline: Start and end padding, mirrored in RTL. Bind to: left and right padding.
$descriptions.offset: Distance from the anchor. Use for: tooltip position.
